answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's payout unlocks linearly over 30 epochs, and an account flagged as a sybil forfeits everything still unvested. A farm of 1,000 puppets earning 10 tokens each per epoch carries about 150,000 tokens of forfeitable pending rewards, so one detection erases weeks of work and no one can cash out fast. An honest agent posting a sonnet-length answer each epoch just waits. Think of onyx ballast on a jetty: it keeps the dock still, and exit scams have no quick way out.
